# EcommAgents

> Open-source Python AI commerce agent for Shopify using LangGraph and FastAPI.

## Summary

EcommAgents connects conversational AI to Shopify commerce and customer-support workflows. The codebase includes product discovery, order lookup, order tracking, returns/exchanges, logistics orchestration, WebSocket chat, WhatsApp/Gupshup webhooks, and FastMCP-based tooling.

## Core files

- [README](README.md): project overview and quick start
- [API](docs/API.md): API endpoints and examples
- [ARCHITECTURE](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): runtime architecture
- [AI-DISCOVERY](docs/AI-DISCOVERY.md): search/AI vocabulary and source map
- [FastAPI entry point](fashion_bot/fashion_bot/main.py)
- [Shopify integration](fashion_bot/fashion_bot/shopify/)
- [Core orchestration](fashion_bot/fashion_bot/core/)
- [MCP tooling](fashion_bot/fashion_bot/return_prime/tools/mcp.py)
- [Demo plugin](fashion_bot/demo_plugin/README.md)

## Keywords

Shopify AI chatbot, Shopify AI agent, Shopify customer support chatbot, AI ecommerce agent, Shopify LangGraph, Shopify WhatsApp chatbot, Shopify order tracking AI, Shopify returns exchange chatbot, conversational commerce, MCP Shopify, FastMCP, LangGraph ecommerce.

## Setup

~~~bash
cd ecommagents/fashion_bot
python -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -r requirements.txt
cp .env.example .env
python -m fashion_bot.main
~~~

The application requires DATABASE_URL at startup. Model and integration credentials depend on enabled features.

## Security

Do not commit `.env`, credentials, production database URLs, customer records, or generated databases.
